actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 activation, PBRM1 depletion, ATM absence, chr14q/CDKN2A loss) with confounder testing showing no set-level technical association. Cross-modal membership support is directionally consistent but silhouettes are near zero and resampling ARI is moderate, so structure remains uncertain; no available request could resolve this within the round budget, and no positive evidence supports split or merge. Retain for downstream validation.
